config.label: Bearer token from https://spoc
config.description: Bearer token from https://spoc.com/settings/api-keys. Omit for anonymous access; required for tools that need a principal (e.g. spoc.harness.issue).

config.label: HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint
config.description: HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://spoc.com/mcp/rpc.

config.label: SSE endpoint for server-initiated notifications
config.description: SSE endpoint for server-initiated notifications. Defaults to https://spoc.com/mcp/events.

config.label: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

config.label: Set to 1 to skip the SSE event stream (notifications become unavailable)
config.description: Set to 1 to skip the SSE event stream (notifications become unavailable).

config.label: Set to 1 to log debug output to stderr
config.description: Set to 1 to log debug output to stderr.
